'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Dialogue==
{{quote|Salam, there's a new sweet deal for you. Recently, I was approached by the guy who’s some sort of Reshala’s acquaintance. Posh as fuck, in a suit, and with a signet on his finger the size of a bottle cap. I’ve seen him at some gathering once, he used to drive a black BMW. He says that war or no war, his crib's gotta be all ornamented. Well, not exactly a crib, more like a hideout. Fetch me a bunch of jewelry, and I’ll hand it over to him. Look for horse statues, cats, lions, all that stuff. And look for Roler watches, the golden ones, it will be a complimentary gift: It’s best to be on good terms with such people, believe me, brother. Don't let me down, brother, or we're both in trouble.}}

== Requirements==
* Must be level 27 to start this quest.

==Objectives==
* Find 2 [[Bronze lion figurine|Bronze lion figurines]] [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]]
* Find 2 [[Horse figurine|Horse figurines]] [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]]
* Find 2 [[Golden rooster figurine|Golden rooster figurines]] [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]]
* Find 2 [[Cat figurine]] [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]]
* Find 2 [[Roler Submariner gold wrist watch]] [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]]
* Find 2 [[Golden egg]] [[Found in raid|<font color="red">in raid</font>]]
* Hand over 2 [[Bronze lion figurine|Bronze lion figurines]] to [[Ragman]]
* Hand over 2 [[Horse figurine|Horse figurines]] to [[Ragman]]
* Hand over 2 [[Golden rooster figurine|Golden rooster figurines]] to [[Ragman]]
* Hand over 2 [[Cat figurine]] to [[Ragman]]
* Hand over 2 [[Roler Submariner gold wrist watch]] to [[Ragman]]
* Hand over 2 [[Golden egg]] to [[Ragman]]

==Rewards==
* +19,900 [[EXP]]
*[[Ragman]] Rep <font color="green">'''+0.75'''</font>
{{quote|From the bottom of my heart. I’ll make the delivery. Such jewelry is always a pleasure to have, I think the guy will like it.}}

The statues/figurines can commonly be found in the furniture displays throughout the store IDEA on [[Interchange]]. Alternatively, they, along with the [[Roler Submariner gold wrist watch]] and [[Golden egg]] can be found in [[Safe]]s. They can also be very rarely be found in other containers such as [[Drawer]]s, [[Sport bag]]s, [[Dead Scav]]s, and more.
